guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice has by far the largest anomalies: latency-90 up 867% (z=+173), latency-50 up 780%, and CPU up 656% (z=+67), with only a minor memory rise (+14.8%), which points to CPU saturation rather than a memory fault. Downstream productcatalogservice latency is unchanged (+2.1%), so the slowdown originates in recommendationservice itself. The worst traces (frontend -> currency -> productcatalog) don't touch recommendationservice and show errors only in frontendservice, and logs contain no warnings or errors, so confidence is medium rather than high.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate recommendationservice for CPU-bound work (e.g. a runaway loop or heavy computation), check recent deploys, and scale out or add CPU limits/replicas as a temporary mitigation; restart the pod only if it's confirmed to be stuck.
